title: Ecuser's Curated Hentai Collection 2020 Edition [ENG SUBS]
description:
![](https://i.imgur.com/KpuVmJh.png)



**What's the TL;DR of this overly long description:** The vast majority of quality H out there all in one torrent, English subbed. **~560 shows** with nearly **1300 episodes**. This is an expansion and refinement of [of my previous Curated Collection](https://sukebei.nyaa.si/view/2789480). Download, enjoy, and seed!

- **What does curated even mean?** I judge the H for its pLoT, voice acting, animation quality, and fetishes covered. I then determine if it's something I (1) want in my regular rotation of fap material, (2) should archive for future research, (3) or delete.

- **That's all very subjective isn't it?** Yes. Yes it is. That being said [I do have fairly broad tastes](https://myanimelist.net/animelist/Ecuser) so chances are you'll find something interesting.

- **Can I get a list of H included in this collection?** Most of the H included in this collection will be on [my MAL](https://myanimelist.net/animelist/Ecuser). Each of them has a numerical rating. Generally a 5-6 means "acceptable"-- good enough to include in the collection. The vast majority of H under 5 rating are deleted. Alternatively, check the files list under this description. I've also included a PDF of my MAL profile in the torrent.

- **What is the quality of the H files?** The best I can find. Many are not 720p or 1080p because the raws weren't HD to begin with-- most 720p or 1080p H streamed online are upscales to begin with. If there were BDs available, I sought to obtain BD rips.

- **This torrent is way too big!** You can selectively download parts of the collection that you're interested in. For example, if you have similar tastes as I do, consider only downloading the `H` folder and ignoring the `H Archived` folder. Another example: if you don't like watching rape, then only grab the `V` folder for consensual content.

- **How is the collection organized?** The torrent is organized into a `H` folder and a `H Archived` folder. The better shows that are in my regular fap rotation are in the `H` folder [generally a score of 5 or above on my MAL]. `H Archived` is for shows that didn't make the cut-- but as tastes differ, you might find something interesting there.

  Each tier is then divided into its defining genre-- MB, R, and V. MB means mind break: non-consensual sex where the victim "converts" and ends up enjoying the rape. R means rape. For the purposes of this collection, it means rape where the victim resists/ does not cave. Generally more brutal than MB. Finally the V folders hold all the consensual sex H-- no rape here.

- **What has changed since the previous Curated Collection?** Err, a lot. Unfortunately, I don't keep meticulous records of my fap patterns. But there have have been significant additions to the Collection (more than 150 GB of quality, new additions). Expect some improvements in naming/ organization as well. And of course, the collection includes all the quality H that have aired/are airing in 2020 at the time of the upload. 

This collection [is compatible with AniTag](https://github.com/Sirosky/AniTag) as shown below.
